story.iWant: set trim points on a clip to remove unwanted sections
story.soThat: I can include only the desired portions of my footage
story.tasks: - Extend Clip data model with trim properties (trimIn, trimOut fields) - Implement timeline store mutation for trim updates (updateClip action) - Create TrimTool component with trim handles UI - Integrate trim tool with Timeline component - Update preview player to respect trim values - Implement non-destructive editing guarantee - Add keyboard support and accessibility - Test trim functionality end-to-end

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: User can select a clip on timeline to enable trim mode AC2: Trim handles appear at clip start and end positions AC3: Dragging trim handles adjusts in/out points with visual feedback AC4: Preview updates to show trimmed region during trim adjustment AC5: Timeline displays trimmed duration accurately AC6: Trimmed clip plays only the selected region in preview AC7: Original imported media file remains unchanged (non-destructive editing)

docs.doc: Epic 3 implements core editing operations including clip trim with in/out points. Trim operations use trimIn/trimOut fields on Clip interface. Non-destructive editing: original source files remain unchanged. Trim handles use GPU-accelerated CSS transforms for 60fps performance per NFR001.

Clip interface extended with trimIn: number and trimOut: number fields. Effective duration calculated as: duration - trimIn - trimOut. Preview playback bounds: video.currentTime = clip.trimIn on load, pause at (duration - trimOut).

EditTools folder at src/renderer/components/EditTools/ for Epic 3 editing components. Shared types in src/renderer/types/timeline.types.ts. State mutations in src/renderer/store/timelineStore.ts. Zustand immutability: use set() with spread operators.
Use Tailwind CSS classes. Trim handles: absolute positioned divs with cursor-ew-resize. Selected clip: ring-2 ring-cyan-500. Drag feedback: opacity-75 during drag, transition-opacity.
Application shall allow users to set in/out trim points on individual clips. NFR001: Timeline UI shall maintain 30+ fps responsiveness with 10 or more clips loaded.

constraints.constraint: Main/renderer process separation: Trim operations are pure renderer-side state mutations (no IPC calls to main process)
Zustand immutability: All clip updates must use set() with spread operators, never mutate state directly
NFR001: Trim handle dragging must maintain 60fps (16ms update cycle) using GPU-accelerated CSS transforms
Non-destructive editing: trimIn/trimOut are playback metadata only, source files must remain untouched
TrimTool component must be created in src/renderer/src/components/EditTools/ folder (new for Epic 3)
Clip interface in src/renderer/src/components/Timeline/timeline.types.ts already has trimIn/trimOut fields defined
